notes: First real Sheets log-over-cellular attempt (BLE 'log' command) got all the way through modem reset/registration/NETOPEN/HTTPDATA-POST, then failed silently: AT+HTTPACTION returned '1,302,0' -- HTTP 302, zero-length body. Root cause: script.google.com/.../exec (Apps Script Web App) ALWAYS answers with a redirect to a script.googleusercontent.com URL that serves the real doPost() response -- this is normal Apps Script behavior, not an error. Invisible from the PC-side apps_script_test.py because Python's urllib follows redirects automatically; the SIM7600's own AT+HTTP* commands do not (checked SIMCom's official manual -- no auto-redirect AT+HTTPPARA option exists). Fixed in cellular.py: on a 301/302/303/307/308 status, read the Location header via AT+HTTPHEAD (the only way to see it -- AT+HTTPREAD only returns the body, which is empty for a redirect) and re-request it (GET, matching what browsers/urllib do when downgrading a redirected POST). Same fix applied to wifi_uplink.py's WifiHttp for when Wi-Fi logging is eventually used -- untested on hardware but would hit the identical bug otherwise.
